crucial_author_statement: In the 1958 Handbook foreword Weiser says this compilation combined his three prior books but left out material of restricted interest including recipes, music and poems. A Handbook-only customs census cannot close the precursor-source completeness gate.

primary_statement_locator.title: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs
primary_statement_locator.pdf_page_index_note: Exact zero-based PDF index for roman-numeral front matter not verified; refer to Foreword itself

rules: Bibliographic confirmation is not a claim that source has been mined.
Precursor books are not independently corroborating the Handbook because they share the same author.
Do not count recipes, textual poems or musical compositions as distinct customs without an identifiable associated traditional practice.
Record any source-exclusive customs alongside overlap mapping to 1958 book.
